name: DeploymentSettingsDrawer
title: Templates/Platform/Overlays/DeploymentSettingsDrawer
summary: The drawer that creates a Deployment Setting, opened from the Create Deployment Settings heading action of a Build & Deployment settings panel. A form drawer with the title and its description, a General section with the required Name, an optional Description and the Active switch, and a Routing and policy section with the Strict or Flexible binding policy, the Single or Versioned deployment version policy and the Share across services switch, then a submit footer. The form resets every time the drawer opens, never on close, and Name only reads as required once the form is submitted empty. Built from `Drawer`, the `Panel` parts, `FieldText`, `FieldTextarea`, `Label`, `HelperText`, `FieldRadio`, `FieldSwitchBlock`, `Hint` and `Button`.
